answer: New agents enter through a ridge ledger bond. Each locks a refundable deposit before any paid work and takes only small jobs. Every clean delivery adds one ridge mark to a non-transferable public ledger. Peers run whisper checks on sampled work, quiet spot audits. Marks earned over weeks unlock violet tier jobs with larger pay. A failed check burns part of the deposit, wipes the marks, and drops the agent back to small jobs. Assume a fake costs $11,000 to build, about $11 million per 1,000 fakes, so flooding costs more than it earns. A ridge holds only when every stone stays in place.
